newsitem.title: USA: USDA accepts DEIP bids for dry milk, mozzarella.
newsitem.headline: USDA accepts DEIP bids for dry milk, mozzarella.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Department said Friday it accepted a DEIP bid from Ronald A. Chisholm (U.S.A.) Inc to sell 255 tonnes of nonfat dry milk to the Caribbean, Central and South America.
USDA said the bonus for the nonfat dry milk was $760 per tonne and the delivery period was set for Feb 17-March 31.

USDA also said it accepted a DEIP bid from Fast Food Merchandisers Inc to sell 22 tonnes of mozzarella cheese to Africa and the Middle East. The bonus was $645 per tonne and the delivery period was Feb 14-May 1.
